content.short: Aldrin is a Solana-based DEX that facilitates token swaps via an AMM and offers spot and futures trading.
content.description: Aldrin is a decentralized exchange on the Solana network designed to make DeFi accessible to users of all experience levels. It launched an automated market maker (AMM) DEX to enable instant token swaps through liquidity pools in October 2021. Formerly Cryptocurrencies.ai, Aldrin offers crypto spot and futures trading on its DEX and provides opportunities to earn passive income by supplying liquidity, with an AMM‑driven model that supports fast, on‑chain trades for a diverse user base.
